rv.q: Still, it’s tough to resist the rainbow bear hug of From Here and hope for its evolution and future.

Pulse Nightclub shooting Good intentions go a long way in the theater—especially with a show based on real-life events. And the Florida-born off-Broadway musical From Here , which reflects on the aftermath of the Pulse Nightclub shooting in Orlando, is built on good intentions, powered by raw emotion, and buttressed by eight years’ worth of grief.
